name: The New Frontier
summary: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm sends you to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus amid mistrust among the Cenarion Circle's leaders. Strange corruptions of Teldrassil continue while their duty remains.

sections.title: At the Enclave
sections.body: Mathrengyl Bearwalker waits at Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave, where he apologizes for the tension. Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm and Keeper Remulos each suspect the other of deception. Strange corruptions of Teldrassil continue, and the Cenarion Circle's duty endures despite its leaders' disagreement.

faq.q: Who is asking me to speak with them?
faq.answer: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm sends you to speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.

faq.q: Where do I find Mathrengyl Bearwalker?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker is at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why is there mistrust between the leaders?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl says Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm and Keeper Remulos each suspect the other of deception. The continuing corruptions of Teldrassil add to the strain.
Strange corruptions of Teldrassil continue despite the disagreement between Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm and Keeper Remulos.

faq.q: What duty remains despite their disagreement?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl says the Cenarion Circle's duty remains, even when its leaders disagree.

angles.text: As a druid, you meet Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave, where the Cenarion Circle's leaders are at odds as Teldrassil's corruptions continue.

attribution: In-game quest text: The New Frontier
